items.title: Halloween Masks
items.creator: The Lucky Petals
items.description: These Halloween masks look epic! Perfect for a costume party or getting into the spirit of Halloween! There are so many mask designs to choose from so why not try them all.

items.title: Royal Mobs
items.creator: The Lucky Petals
items.description: Roleplay as elegant mobs and build an enormous castle fit for wealthy royals! These skins were made for when you decided to rule over the land and create an empire surrounded by your kingdom. Which royal mob will you choose?

items.title: Techno Rainbows
items.creator: The Lucky Petals
items.description: It's party time and this is a techno rainbow party! These skins are perfect for standing out in front of everyone, no one will be able to keep their eyes off you! You can't help look this amazing though so just dance the night away! A colorful party awaits you and your friends.

items.title: Galaxy Teens
items.creator: 4KS Studios
items.description: Galaxy teens shoot for the stars! With galactic colors, shine like a supernova with these skins!

items.title: Rainbow Teen Fashion
items.creator: Pixelusion
items.description:
Stand out from the crowd with these super cool and colorful rainbow fashion outfits!

- 21 colorful skins
- 1 free skin
- By Pixelusion & Lostduckies

items.title: Rainbow Gamers
items.creator: Pixelusion
items.description:
Ready to be the top-notch gamers of the world? Pick your favorite rainbow gaming outfit and enjoy your game!

- 21 colorful skins
- 1 free skin
- By Pixelusion & Lostduckies

items.title: Hexagon Survival
items.creator: Pixelusion
items.description:
Are you bored with playing in a normal world? We have an exciting challenge for you! In this map, each hexagon is a different adventure! Start discovering the hexagons, make trades, fight monsters and improve your equipment.

- An epic survival challenge
- By Pixelusion & Bone Block Designs

items.title: Randomized Skyblock
items.creator: Pixelusion
items.description:
The classic Skyblock experience, but with a twist… The islands are made from a VERY large variety of blocks!
So if you want a specific one… Try to find it!

- A Skyblock experience, but with random islands!
- Tons of fun alone or with your friends!
- By Pixelusion

items.title: Memes
items.creator: Pixelusion
items.description:
Do you know all the memes? Find your favourite ones within this pack, from the Doge to the Thinking Emoji, everyone is there!
So are you dank enough?

- 10 famous memes skins!
- Perfect to attract all eyes on you!
- By Pixelusion

items.title: Masked Teens
items.creator: DogHouse
items.description:
Always wanted to be a cool teen with a neon bunny mask, which gives the illusion to glow in the dark? Then this package ist perfect for you and your friends!

-includes 12 different skins
-perfect for roleplay
-have fun!

items.title: Witch Underground Base
items.creator: Mine-North
items.description:
Find the secret underground base of the witch and discover it for yourself! 

+ Secret underground entrance
+ Full interior
+ Survival

Created by Mine-North

items.title: Faces of Loki
items.creator: 4KS Studios
items.description:
The trickster god is known for his many faces. Sometimes he's especially devious and takes the face of another. Are you Loki?

+ 12 roleplay skins!
+ Devious attire inspired by Norse mythology!

items.title: Lucky Blocks Desert Paradise
items.creator: 4KS Studios
items.description:
Lucky blocks are just about around every corner of this desert city! Find out what luck has in it for you today!

+ 10 lucky blocks!
+ Over 100 lucky or unlucky events!

items.title: Millionaire Mansion Luxury
items.creator: 4KS Studios
items.description: A life of luxury and fun awaits! Everything here is yours to enjoy! Find out what secrets this mansion holds for you!

items.title: Millionaire Hideout
items.creator: 4KS Studios
items.description: Every millionaire needs their own getaway vacation! Some need a hideout to really escape. Your own millionaire hideout mansion is here to fill that need! Enjoy your privacy in peace!

items.title: Elemental Dragon Riders
items.creator: Hourglass Studios
items.description:
Tame the Skies and ride into battle with these epic elemental dragon rider skins! The Bedrock Knights show unwavering strength in battle, the humble Earth Vikings command the land to their will and the Cloud Valkyries soar the skies with ease. Which clan will you choose for your next adventure?

- 16 elemental rider skins!
- 8 elements!
- By: Hourglass Studios

items.title: Dragon Goat Protectors
items.creator: Hourglass Studios
items.description:
Become one with the goats! These goats are meant for protecting the dragons in a far away kingdom from all the evil that lurks. The goats, known as the Dragon Emerald Mountain Elders, are found in the deepest of all mountains! Embark with these epic skins and protect the cliffs of the high mountains from darkness! Be the light! 

- 9 goaty skins!
- By: Hourglass Studios

items.title: Ultra Hard Survival: Hexed
items.creator: IBXToyMaps
items.description: This map is deliberately very hard. The life has been taken away from this world… or, the friendly life at least. The witches have scattered the 16 colours of concrete across the hexed landscape and retrieving them is beyond dangerous.
items.changelog:
- World updated to 26.40 Chaos Cubed
- Added support for Vibrant Visuals
- New music discs (from 1.20 onwards) have been hidden around the world

items.title: Cool Ores II
items.creator: Netherpixel
items.description:
These ores are even cooler than the previous ones, with them you will not only come out of the mine with all the minerals you want, but you will also be a mineral yourself!

- 18 beautiful skins.
- 2 skins totally free.
- By DragonClub Studios.

items.title: Luxury Freestyle Teens
items.creator: Fall Studios
items.description:
You want to wear luxurious clothes and be one of the freestyle teens? With these 8 skins you will be one of the coolest among your friends!

+By FALL Studios

items.title: Crowned Fashion Teens
items.creator: Fall Studios
items.description:
The Fashion Teens were crowned! Choose one of these 8 cool skins and be one of them!

+8 HQ teen skins!
+By FALL Studios

items.title: Mob Fashion Stars
items.creator: Fall Studios
items.description:
What is your favorite mob? Pick one of these 8 fashion skins and show everyone your cool new style!

+8 HQ mob skins!
+By FALL Studios

items.title: Bunny Island
items.creator: 4KS Studios
items.description:
Explore an ancient island and find all its treasures! Find all of the hidden areas and get incredible loot! Do you think you can find them all? Let's find out!

+ Giant beautiful island!
+ Hidden treasures!

- By Orbital Studios and 4KS Studios

items.title: Teen Elementals
items.creator: Sapphire Studios
items.description: These teens have mastered and become a part of their element. All that is left is to be the master of them all! Which is your favorite element?
